Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury)

The Neo-Hwacha, a Tyger Claw design, delivers ample firepower at a minimal size. To compensate for its lack of support for heavier calibers, its users typically equip it with autoloaders or belt feeds.

An oversized Battleglove (CP:R, pg. 347) that covers the user’s forearm and hand. The hand covered by this Battleglove cannot be utilized for any purpose while the Battleglove is being worn. Comes preinstalled with 2 non-removable Popup Ranged Weapons (with no preinstalled weapons) and has 1 additional Option Slot for Cyberarm or Cyberlimb Options, but cannot accept Cyberhands nor Cyberhand Options. When worn, the options stored in the Battleglove can be accessed.

Brawling and Martial Arts Attacks made with an arm wearing a Neo-Hwacha Battleglove suffer a -4 penalty. Uniquely, weapons installed into a Neo-Hwacha Battleglove’s Popup Ranged Weapons’ (which must still be provided by the user) are not installed permanently, and can be swapped out with a DV17 Weaponstech Check and 4 hours.

Putting on or taking off a Battleglove is an Action. The cost to purchase and install a Cyberarm option into the Battleglove is the same cost as doing so in a Cyberarm. Any options stored in a Cyberarm or meat arm the Battleglove is being worn over are inaccessible while the Battleglove is being worn. Cannot be concealed.

Type: Cyberarm (Foundational)
Install: Mall
Humanity Loss: None
Option Slots: uses 1, provides 1

Foundry notes:

  • Worn, not surgically installed: no Humanity Loss.
  • The two built-in Popup Ranged Weapons are described here; install the core system's Popup Ranged Weapon items into it if you want them on the sheet.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware Alternatives > Battle/Smart Gloves).
